gloss: to be no match for; to be unable to hold one's head up before

definitions.gloss: to be unable to hold one's head up before someone; to be no match for
definitions.explanation: To feel unable to assert oneself in front of someone because of a debt of gratitude, their authority, or one's own past failings; literally 'one's head does not rise', as in a permanent bow. The person is marked with に: {妻|つま}には{頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらない.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらない。
examples.english: I can't stand up to my wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧になった⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらない。
examples.english: I still can't hold my head up before the senior who looked after me back then.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}して→返す：09648_kaesu⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらないで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Ever since his brother paid off his debt for him, he has been unable to hold his head up before him.

notes:
Literally 'one's head does not rise': the image is of a bow one can never come up from. The person is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, usually ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらない: to be unable to stand up to ~
- {頭|あたま}が{上|あ}がらない⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: someone one can never stand up to

USAGE:
Said of a spouse, a benefactor, a former teacher, or anyone whose help or authority leaves one permanently in the weaker position. Often half-joking, especially about one's wife or husband.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げる→頭を下げる：26795_atamawosageru⟧: to bow; to apologize — a single act, not a lasting relationship
- ⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to owe someone a debt of gratitude — states the debt without the image of submission
